name: Warlock
fantasy: The Harrower: a gnome who struck a bargain with the crows of the Hollow. He rots foes from the inside, terrifies them into flight and drinks what is left, with Fiddlesticks' dread and hunger in fel green. A run takes him down one of three roads: Corruption (stacking curses), Fear (crowd control) or Drain (life drain that overflows into shields).

directions.name: Corruption
directions.desc: Damage over time, WoW-style: cheap curses that stack, spells that grow with every curse on a foe and how long it has been cursed, and a finisher that cashes them all in.

directions.name: Fear
directions.desc: Crowd control: terrify, bind and scatter. Feared foes flee, panic spreads, and the crows take whatever stops running.

directions.name: Drain
directions.desc: Life drain: beams and bolts that heal, healing past full life that hardens into a shield, and a feast at the end.

skills.name: Drain Life
skills.desc: Latch a green beam onto an enemy and pull the life out of it. The beam forks to up to 3 enemies near your target and everything it drains heals you. Hold Q to keep draining (costs mana each second).

skills.name: Blight Bolt
skills.desc: Hurl a howling skull of blight. It bursts where it lands and leaves a plague pool that rots enemies standing in it for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Soul Shackles
skills.desc: Chains of fel fire snap out to every enemy within 7 metres, damaging them and binding them in place for 2.5 seconds.

skills.name: Fel Covenant
skills.desc: Seal a pact with what waits beyond: +40% damage for 12 seconds, and Drain Life forks to two more enemies and heals twice as much.

skills.name: Corruption
skills.desc: Curse a foe up to 15 m away, instantly: 120% spell damage over 10 seconds. Cheap, and recasting refreshes it. Your bread-and-butter DoT.
skills.needs: A DoT status on Enemy (stacking by source), a cast with no wind-up.

skills.name: Malediction
skills.desc: A fel bolt for 60% spell damage, +50% for every one of your DoTs on the target (up to 5: 310%).
skills.needs: Count the caster's DoTs on a foe.

skills.name: Unending Rot
skills.desc: A curse for 12 seconds whose ticks grow 15% stronger for every second the foe has carried at least one of your DoTs without a break. A clean foe starts again from nothing.
skills.needs: Track how long a foe has been continuously afflicted.

skills.name: Festering Hex
skills.desc: A hex for 15 seconds: every 5 seconds it bursts for 80% spell damage and stuns the foe for 0.5 seconds (players: diminishing returns).
skills.needs: A periodic stun through PvpStatus for players.

skills.name: Leeching Curse
skills.desc: A curse for 8 seconds: 100% spell damage over its life, and every tick heals you for 50% of what it dealt.
skills.needs: A DoT whose ticks heal the caster.

skills.name: Reckoning
skills.desc: Call in the debt: the target instantly takes everything your DoTs on it would still deal. They keep running.
skills.needs: Sum the remaining damage of the caster's DoTs on a foe.

skills.name: Terrify
skills.desc: Point at a foe within 8 m: it flees in terror for 1.5 seconds (players 1 second, with diminishing returns) and takes 20% more damage from you meanwhile.
skills.needs: A fear on monsters (flee AI) and the PvP fear status.

skills.name: Scarecrow Effigy
skills.desc: Plant a scarecrow up to 12 m away for 8 seconds. The first three foes to come within 4 m are feared for 1 second as it caws. Players can break it in 3 blows.
skills.needs: A placed trap object (PvpObjects for players) and the scarecrow model.

skills.name: Dark Wind
skills.desc: Send a crow at a foe: it bounces between up to 5 enemies, 70% spell damage and a 1-second slow each. Feared or bound foes take double.
skills.needs: A bouncing projectile (SharedSkills.chain pattern) and a crow model.

skills.name: Crowstorm
skills.desc: Channel for 1.5 seconds, then blink up to 8 m: a storm of crows whirls 5 m round you for 5 seconds, 60% spell damage every half second. Everything caught when it lands is feared for 1 second.
skills.needs: A channel, a blink, an area that follows the caster.

skills.name: Leech Bolt
skills.desc: A quick shadow bolt: 100% spell damage, and 30% of it heals you.
skills.needs: A projectile that heals on hit.

skills.name: Bountiful Harvest
skills.desc: Sweep a scythe of shadow round you (5 m): 140% spell damage; each foe hit heals you 4% of your life (8% when it is the only one).
skills.needs: An arc on the skill format plus a heal per target.

skills.name: Soul Feast
skills.desc: Channel for up to 3 seconds: a beam to every foe within 7 m drains 50% spell damage a second from each. Healing past full life becomes a shield up to 30% of your life.
skills.needs: Drain Life's beams to every foe in range, and the shield from Blood Ward.
